latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Image to Video Dance:

- Instantly animates still images into dance videos using cloud AI — no local setup required.
- Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC uploads (up to 200MB).
- Automatic token and session management with clear status updates.
- Exports 1080p MP4 dance clips, optimized for social media.
- Guides users with simple prompts; handles credit status and error messaging seamlessly.
